title: 第11章 一日供应两餐第12章 这辈子都值得了
slug: 饥荒年我囤货娇养了古代大将军
lines: 陈魁见战承胤面色不佳，担忧地问：“将军，京城递来何消息？”
战承胤把信件递给他。
他展开信，几位将士都围过来看。
只见信上写‘死守’二字！
陈魁气的当场骂娘，“老子原本有一万士兵，现在只剩下几百，不给粮不给水，没有救援，还让老子死守！”
“这不就是让下面的人去送死？”
吴三郎双眉紧蹙，“将军，真的没有救援吗？”
他们虽然有了粮草，可两万士兵如何抵挡三十万蛮族！
一旦他们有水有粮消息透露出去，蛮族定会两天内攻破城池，把所有粮食都抢了去。
空气如尘，气氛压抑！
陈武又道：“徐怀将军的十万人马，距离镇关不过几百里，小皇帝没有下令他来救援，难道眼睁睁看着镇关失守，战家军全军覆灭？”
战承胤英俊眉宇紧拧，他不会让最后两万战家军阵亡！
可两万对阵三十万大军~
他要怎么打？
怎么去赢？
历史上有以少胜多的战役，却没有兵力差距悬殊如此之大的情况。
“能联系上徐怀将军吗？”战承胤问。
“将军，您是想向他借兵？”宋铎忧心忡忡道：“他向来愚忠，未必会帮咱们解围。”
蛮族三十万人，徐怀才十万人！
于公于私，他都不会出头！
战承胤说：“给他带去些粮食，让他的属下呈给他！”
他再愚忠，再对小皇帝唯命是从~
如果不能让手下将士吃饱，他下面人知道战家军有粮，会想法设法来解镇关之围！
陈武沉声道：“将军，此事末将想办法，把信送出去！”
战承胤单手负后，抬头望天。
天色黑沉，四周风沙呼呼的刮，吹着残垣断臂发出渗人声音。
“米粮趁夜色送去军营，记住封锁消息！”
若是蛮族打探到城内有粮水，一定会疯狂进攻。
将士们应下。
半夜，将军府外面的百姓都在睡梦中，军营中来了一队人，他们悄悄提竹筐从后门进入将军府。
当看见主堂内大米面粉面条泡面油盐……堆满整个房间。
content_en:
Seeing Zhan Chengyin's poor expression, Chen Kui asked worriedly: "General, what news is there from the capital?"
Zhan Chengyin handed him the letter.
He opened the letter, and several soldiers gathered around to read it.
I saw the word ‘defend’ written on the letter!
Chen Kui scolded his mother on the spot angrily, "I originally had 10,000 soldiers, but now I only have a few hundred left. They don't provide food, water, or rescue, and yet you still let me defend!"
"Isn't this just asking the people below to die?"
Wu Sanlang frowned, "General, is there really no rescue?"
Although they have food and grass, how can 20,000 soldiers resist 300,000 barbarians!
Once the news was revealed that they had water and food, the barbarians would definitely attack the city within two days and snatch all the food.
The air is dusty and the atmosphere is depressing!
Chen Wu added: "General Xu Huai's 100,000 troops are only a few hundred miles away from the town pass. The little emperor didn't order him to come to the rescue. Could it be that he just watched the town pass fall and the entire Zhan family army be destroyed?"
Zhan Chengyin's handsome eyebrows tightened, he would not let the last 20,000 Zhan family troops die in battle!
But 20,000 people can face an army of 300,000 people~
How is he going to fight?
How to win?
There have been battles in history where a small number of people defeated a large number, but there has never been such a huge disparity in military strength.
"Can you contact General Xu Huai?" Zhan Chengyin asked.
"General, do you want to borrow troops from him?" Song Duo said worriedly: "He has always been foolish and loyal, so he may not be able to help us rescue the siege."
There are 300,000 barbarians, and Xu Huaicai has only 100,000 people!
Whether in public or private matters, he will not stand out!
Zhan Chengyin said: "Bring him some food and let his subordinates present it to him!"
No matter how foolish and loyal he is, no matter how obedient he is to the little emperor~
If he can't keep his soldiers well-fed, his subordinates will find ways to break the siege of Zhenguan if they know that the Zhan family's army has food!
Chen Wu said in a deep voice: "General, we will find a way to send the letter out at the end of this matter!"
Zhan Chengyin put his hands behind his back and looked up at the sky.
The sky was dark, and the wind and sand were blowing all around, blowing on the broken walls and making a permeating sound.
"Send rice grains to the military camp at night, remember the news of the blockade!"
If the barbarians find out that there is food and water in the city, they will attack madly.
The soldiers responded.
In the middle of the night, when the people outside the general's mansion were sleeping, a group of people came from the military camp. They quietly entered the general's mansion through the back door carrying bamboo baskets.
When I saw rice, flour, noodles, instant noodles, oil and salt in the main hall, the whole room was filled.
title_en: Chapter 11 Two meals a day Chapter 12 This life is worth it
